purpose: Side-by-side image/host record for the R2 canary (jay-mac, 2026-09-30) against Phase 4B's recorded provenance (soham-local, data/audit/phase4b_manifest.json), so a later timing discrepancy has something concrete to check against.

phase4b_soham_local.observability: prometheus and grafana STOPPED for all 72 Phase 4B runs
phase4b_soham_local.note: order_image_id/toxiproxy_image_id/architecture were never recorded in phase4b_manifest.json -- not that they matched jay-mac's, simply absent from the source.

r2_canary_jay_mac.source: docker image inspect, run 2026-09-30 immediately before the canary
r2_canary_jay_mac.observability: prometheus and grafana were RUNNING during the canary (not stopped) -- confirmed via `docker ps` immediately beforehand

comparable: gateway_image_repo (both infra-gateway-service, both built by this repo's own two-stage Dockerfile)
not_comparable: gateway_image_id -- DIFFERENT digest: Phase 4B's is sha256:ce110c0a..., jay-mac's canary is sha256:c281f7db... Different build, not the same artifact. Both postdate D25 (2026-09-18) by source inspection (see docs/paper/decision-log.md D25), but a differing digest means this cannot be verified from the digest alone -- only from re-reading each image's packaged application.yml.
order_image_id / toxiproxy_image_id -- Phase 4B's manifest never recorded these; nothing to compare jay-mac's values against.
architecture -- Phase 4B's manifest never recorded this either. jay-mac is confirmed arm64; soham-local's architecture is unknown from this record.

observability state -- a REAL, known difference, not just an absent field: Phase 4B ran with Prometheus/Grafana stopped for all 72 runs; the R2 canary ran with both live. Phase 4B's own manifest note says this matters if it differs from a collection it's being compared against -- it does here.
going_forward: The canary ran with Prometheus/Grafana live -- that's a one-time, known deviation from Phase 4B's conditions, scoped to these 4 quarantined rows. The R2 sweep itself will match Phase 4B: Prometheus and Grafana stopped before launch and kept stopped throughout, per docs/paper/r2-equal-exposure-plan.md section 2 (launch procedure) and section 8. The sweep's own launch manifest will record which observability services were running, the same way phase4b_manifest.json does.
